bio: MANNA blends fashion and cosmopolitan flair in a building full of character. Out front, there's a charming city terrace; inside, no fewer than five private dining rooms await, along with luxurious hotel rooms upstairs. Fish takes centre stage here, but meat lovers and vegetarians are equally well catered for. The plates presented are just as on trend as the setting. Whether you are in the mood for a bento box starter, followed by a succulent entrecôte with a balsamic-infused roasting jus, or sea bass baked in a salt crust, MANNA delivers. Alternatively, indulge in a super fresh seafood platter from the fish bar. This is your go-to spot, open daily for both lunch and dinner....
